policy: ESSENTIAL runs on PRs and merge groups plus changed-area cases. GATED-FULL is implicit for every unlisted discovery; manifests contain tier exceptions and scheduling/deletion metadata. NIGHTLY includes never-gated browser cases. Runtime reconciliation gates new cases without warnings and drops stale explicit entries with warnings; implicit browser routing follows native discovery. Known-flaky cases and deletion candidates cannot be ESSENTIAL; AEON-679 rule B removes reviewed low-value categories; protected candidates stay available.
